newsitem.title: USA: Fonar reports $2.5 mln sale of scanners.
newsitem.headline: Fonar reports $2.5 mln sale of scanners.

text.p: Fonar Corp said Monday two more of their QUAD 12000 high-field open MRI scanners have been sold. The company said the total value of these two sales, including service contracts, is approximately $2,500,000.
One of the new scanners, said Fonar, will be installed in the northeast and the other will replace an older FONAR unit in Asia. Installations will take place in the second half of 1997.

The company also said that it expects current customers with multiple orders will request their second scanner by fall. To meet anticipated orders, FONAR said it has added nearly 30,000 square feet of factory space, where it is building a state-of-the-art manufacturing center. This new facility will be operational in May and will reach full capacity shortly thereafter.
FONAR Corporation makes and sells magnetic resonance imaging scanners.
